cards.takeaway: A fine is not the owner's choice. It is an option only where the law allows it.

sourceTrace.heading: 10. 서울 사건은 변경됐고, 부산 사건은 두 번째 심판에서 막혔습니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: Got an advance notice? Check these four first

body.text: Does the governing law allow a fine in place of a suspension?
Is this violation, or this count of violations, excluded?
Do past violations or past fines block conversion again?
Compare the expected fine with your real losses from a suspension.

cards.takeaway: Whether it is legally possible and whether it actually pays are separate questions.
cards.design: Four rows; highlight only the fourth (payoff)
cards.oneMessage: Got an advance notice? Check these four first

sourceTrace.heading: 30초 만에 먼저 확인해 보세요
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: Not an admin fine: a fine that replaces suspension

body.text: Here, a fine imposed in place of a business suspension.
A separate non-criminal penalty for breaching duties such as reporting obligations.
Decide first whether to ask for cancellation, a shorter period, or conversion to a fine.

cards.takeaway: “I'll pay an admin fine instead of the suspension” is not a choice owners get to make.
cards.design: The two terms as large contrasting words
cards.oneMessage: Not an admin fine: a fine that replaces suspension

sourceTrace.heading: 5. 과징금과 과태료는 다른 제도입니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: In Seoul, a 15-day suspension became a fine
body: Seoul Metropolitan Administrative Appeals Commission 2024-01195, Sept. 23, 2024
The violation was confirmed, but given the circumstances, the 15-day suspension became a fine in its place.
Contesting the violation and asking to change the sanction's form are different moves.
cards.takeaway: A violation that is hard to deny can still leave room for a fine conversion.
cards.design: Gavel illustration beside the ruling label
cards.oneMessage: In Seoul, a 15-day suspension became a fine

sourceTrace.heading: 1. 실제로 영업정지 15일이 과징금으로 변경된 사건이 있습니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: Same suspension, different structure by law

body.text: The Food Sanitation Act looks at violation type, count, and the exclusions in Annex 23.
The Wastes Control Act sets separate legal tests, such as waste piling up or business disruption.
First tell a general suspension apart from one for falling short of registration standards.

cards.takeaway: Start with the provision behind this sanction, not the industry name.
cards.oneMessage: Same suspension, different structure by law

sourceTrace.heading: 2. 내 사건도 가능한지는 ‘업종’보다 ‘근거조항’을 먼저 봐야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: First screen out cases that can't convert
body: The sanction provision itself gives no basis for a fine in place of suspension
This violation, or this count of violations, is excluded by law
A past fine or similar sanction bars conversion for a set period
Only business losses are argued, without proving the legal conversion requirements
cards.takeaway: If conversion is off the table, another response comes before estimating the fine.
cards.design: Cross marks; highlight the fourth item (proof of requirements)
cards.oneMessage: First screen out cases that can't convert

sourceTrace.heading: 3. 과징금 전환이 막히는 사건은 먼저 걸러야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: A medical waste firm's 1.5-month suspension stood
body: The firm cited waste piling up at client hospitals and infection risk, but with other disposal firms available, conversion was not found necessary.
In the end, the 1.5-month suspension stood.
cards.takeaway: Harm to clients is a different question from the legal requirements for conversion.
cards.oneMessage: A medical waste firm's 1.5-month suspension stood

sourceTrace.heading: 4. 의료폐기물 업체는 거래처 피해를 주장했지만 과징금 전환이 인정되지 않았습니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: Reduced, then asked again for a fine: dismissed

body.text: Reduced in the first administrative appeal

cards.takeaway: After a ruling, the same sanction can't be appealed again, so set your ask in the first appeal.
cards.design: Two bars, then a broken line ending in a 'Dismissed' stamp
cards.oneMessage: Reduced, then asked again for a fine: dismissed

sourceTrace.heading: 9. “일단 감경받고 나중에 과징금으로 바꾸면 되지 않을까요?”
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: Three cases: the industry was not what decided them

body.text: Seoul restaurant: changed to a fine after the circumstances were weighed.
Medical waste firm: upheld, as conversion was not found necessary.
Busan restaurant: a second claim for a fine, after the reduction, was dismissed.

cards.takeaway: In each case, the circumstances, the conversion tests, and the timing of the claim decided the outcome.
cards.oneMessage: Three cases: the industry was not what decided them

sourceTrace.heading: 10. 서울 사건은 변경됐고, 부산 사건은 두 번째 심판에서 막혔습니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 영문은 국문 문장 수를 따르지 않고 같은 사실·한정어로 다시 썼다

cards.headline: Weigh eligibility and payoff together

body.text: Check the notice's governing law, violated provision, violation count, planned period; gather past sanction, sales and client records.
Exclusions, limits from repeat violations or a past fine, and whether to seek cancellation, reduction or conversion need case-by-case review.

cards.takeaway: Before the deadline, a free review of your notice and past sanctions shows eligibility and next steps.
cards.design: Two stacked boxes; the review box in navy
